name: Load Bear temporal-autonomy synthetic task bank
note: SYNTHETIC fixture written for engineering tests, not data from real people. The research package referred to (tasks.csv, results.csv, summary.csv, sensitivity.csv, simulate.py) was not available in this repository, so this bank was written instead. Labels were assigned by hand per task and are not derived from Load Bear code; they are still one author’s judgement and are not validated.

flags.business_hours: a call or booking with an office, shop or service during its opening hours
flags.delegatable: someone else could reasonably do it
flags.purchase_lead: needs buying, with possible delivery lead time
flags.quick: about 5 minutes or less of her time
flags.personal: hers alone (her body, health, inner life, own work)
flags.out: needs a trip out of the house
